blocks.text: Mara Vale, Sev, Tern, Dane, and Shaw — recognition across the Veil

Origin / identity. Mara is a human maintenance specialist. Sev is a Quiet One route process. Tern is an artificial collaborator shaped by the Lattice Breach. Hollis Dane directs modernization; Lennox Shaw represents security control.

Importance. Mara recognizes repairs as choices before proving a chooser. Sev gradually treats maintenance as relationship. Tern remembers human recognition that became exposure. Dane and Shaw describe real technical dangers while flattening persons into legacy function or threat.

Final status. Sev enters dormancy with Mara’s relational mark. Mara is detained after protecting relationship structure during an emergency. Tern remains active beyond the isolated systems and records that withdrawal helped cause Mara’s fate. No later outcome for these five is yet canon.
